headline: The Academy handed out its first awards in fifteen minutes, and in October the market fell for six days
texture: The Wall Street Crash ran from October 24 to 29 and wiped out a decade of paper gains in a handful of sessions. Hoover had been inaugurated in March into what everyone assumed was a continuing boom. The airship LZ 127 Graf Zeppelin had flown around the world in 21 days that August, and Bernt Balchen, Richard Byrd, Ashley McKinley and Harold June became the first to fly over the South Pole on November 29. The Museum of Modern Art opened in New York on November 7, nine days after the worst of it, having been planned when money was still easy.

The first Academy Awards were presented on May 16 in a fifteen-minute ceremony at the Hollywood Roosevelt, honouring films from the previous two years, and Wings won. The Broadway Melody outsold every other picture and took the second ceremony's top prize. Four of the year's five biggest films were musicals, which is what happens when sound is eighteen months old.

Five men were shot dead in a Chicago garage on February 14 by killers dressed as police, in a Capone operation against a rival gang. The Lateran Treaty was ratified on June 7, making Vatican City a state. John Logie Baird's thirty-line television system was transmitted experimentally from August 20, and Vladimir Zworykin patented a colour system in November, neither of which anyone could watch.

pol.valentines_massacre.label: Saint Valentine's Day Massacre
pol.valentines_massacre.value: Five gangsters, rivals of Al Capone, were shot dead in a Chicago garage by killers dressed as police

world.wall_street_crash.label: Wall Street Crash
world.wall_street_crash.value: Three multi-digit percentage falls between October 24 and 29 wiped more than $30 billion off the New York Stock Exchange, ten times the annual budget of the federal government

world.lateran_treaty.label: Lateran Treaty ratified
world.lateran_treaty.value: Made Vatican City a sovereign state

world.kellogg_briand_effect.label: Kellogg-Briand Pact takes effect
world.kellogg_briand_effect.value: The treaty renouncing war as an instrument of foreign policy came into force in July

film.awards_first.label: First Academy Awards
film.awards_first.value: Presented in a fifteen-minute ceremony at the Hollywood Roosevelt, with Wings taking the top prize
film.awards_first.detail: The awards covered films released across the previous two years rather than one.

film.best_picture.label: Best Picture
film.best_picture.detail: Awarded at the second ceremony, held the following spring. It was also the year's highest-grossing film.

film.gross.label: Highest-grossing films, US domestic rentals
value: Gold Diggers of Broadway, $2,540,000, Warner Bros.
film.gross.detail: Rentals, the distributor share rather than the ticket window total, so roughly half what a gross figure would say. Four of the five were musicals.

film.how_people_watched.label: How people watched
film.how_people_watched.value: In a theatre wired for sound, if the theatre had been able to afford the conversion. Silent production was ending.

tech.baird_broadcast.label: Baird's television transmitted
tech.baird_broadcast.value: His experimental thirty-line system began going out from August 20

tech.color_television_patent.label: Colour television patented
tech.color_television_patent.value: Vladimir Zworykin took out the first patent

culture.moma.label: Museum of Modern Art opens
culture.moma.value: Opened to the public in New York, nine days after the worst of the crash

culture.mood.label: Mood
culture.mood.value: Nine months of certainty and then six days that took it away. Nobody in October knew how long the consequences would run.

sports.world_series.label: World Series
sports.world_series.value: Philadelphia Athletics beat the Chicago Cubs

deaths.buick.label: David Dunbar Buick
deaths.buick.detail: Scottish-American inventor, who gave his name to the car company.

deaths.gutierrez_guerra.label: Jose Gutierrez Guerra
deaths.gutierrez_guerra.detail: Bolivian economist and statesman, president of Bolivia.

notes: Research pass July 2026. No prices section: the three price series all start later. This is the first year with an awards section, because the film.awards window opens with the first ceremony held in May. Two awards facts appear as a result, the first ceremony as a dated 1929 event and the Best Picture for this year's films at the second ceremony, which follows the convention used on every later page. Four of five biggest films being musicals is counted from the source table.
